{{Quote|Now, I need some ''data'' for the casino ''rating tapes.'' What's your ''specialty?''|Unidentified Big Game administrator|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 20">[[Star Wars (1977) 20|''Star Wars'' (1977) 20]]</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''administrator''' helped outfit the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiators]] who signed up to participate in [[the Big Game]], a fighting competition on [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] outfitted the Human [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] with a [[power mace]] and [[power shield]] when the combatant refused to name his preferred [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]].
